business_summary: Lanzhou LS Heavy Equipment Co., Ltd engages in the research and development, manufacture, and maintenance services of traditional energy and chemical, new energy, industrial intelligent equipment, and energy-saving and environmental protection equipment in China and internationally. The company offers various high-end pressure vessels, including reforming reactors, plate-welded and forged-welded hydrogenation reactors, high-pressure tubular reactors, threaded locking ring heat exchangers, diaphragm heat exchangers, high-pressure separation vessels, and large towers; gasifiers, converters, oil-coal slurry heat exchangers and intermediate heat exchangers, Fischer-Tropsch reactors, waste heat boilers; as well as reactors, vaporizers, reaction vessels, heat exchangers, and special-material containers. It also provides nuclear power plant pressure vessels, storage tanks, plate and micro-channel heat exchangers, fuel storage systems; and loading and unloading systems for high-temperature gas-cooled reactor nuclear power plants. In addition, the company offers nuclear fuel cycle reprocessing plants, extraction equipment, reprocessing head-end special equipment, product storage and transportation containers, chambers, and other equipment. Further, it provides alkaline water electrolysis hydrogen production equipment and proton exchange equipment; gaseous hydrogen storage containers and microchannel heat exchangers (PCHE); high-temperature molten salt energy storage, compressed air energy storage, and compressed carbon dioxide energy storage; new metal materials, such as resistant alloys, titanium and copper alloys, steels, and structural steel materials; high-speed forging hydraulic presses, radial forging machines, plate hydraulic forming machines, and hot die forging presses; and engineering design, technical consulting, and raw material inspection and testing services. Lanzhou LS Heavy Equipment Co., Ltd was founded in 1953 and is headquartered in Lanzhou, China.
business_summary_ko: Lanzhou LS Heavy Equipment Co., Ltd는 중국 및 국제적으로 전통 에너지 및 화학, 신에너지, 산업용 지능형 장비, 에너지 절약 및 환경 보호 장비의 연구 개발, 제조 및 유지 관리 서비스에 종사하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 개질 반응기, 판 용접 및 단조 용접 수소화 반응기, 고압 관형 반응기, 나사형 잠금 링 열 교환기, 다이어프램 열 교환기, 고압 분리 용기 및 대형 타워를 포함한 다양한 고급 압력 용기를 제공합니다. 가스화기, 변환기, 석유-석탄 슬러리 열 교환기 및 중간 열 교환기, Fischer-Tropsch 원자로, 폐열 보일러; 반응기, 기화기, 반응용기, 열교환기, 특수재료용기 등도 포함됩니다. 또한 원자력 발전소 압력 용기, 저장 탱크, 판형 및 마이크로 채널 열교환기, 연료 저장 시스템을 제공합니다. 고온 가스 냉각 원자로 원자력 발전소의 적재 및 하역 시스템. 또한, 핵연료주기 재처리 플랜트, 추출 장비, 재처리 헤드엔드 특수 장비, 제품 보관 및 운송 서비스를 제공합니다.
